text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly down over the past day, suggesting consolidation rather than directional conviction at current levels. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 67 but has lost 7 points over the week, signaling that euphoria is cooling slightly even as sentiment remains constructive. BTC dominance at 58.7% and modest $65B daily volume indicate a market without strong risk-on or risk-off momentum—traders appear cautious but not panicked.
